basics.name: Saurabh Shinde
basics.label: AI Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Agentic AI
basics.headline: AI Engineer | LLMs, RAG & Agentic AI | MSc AI | AWS Certified ML Engineer
basics.summary: AI Engineer with 4+ years of experience building, evaluating and deploying LLM, RAG and agentic AI applications, alongside classical ML and MLOps pipelines. Delivered governed LLM workstreams aligned with the EU AI Act, built guardrails and content-moderation logic, and shipped Python services on AWS and Azure with Docker and CI/CD. Experienced in prompt engineering, vector search, LLM evaluation (RAGAS, LLM-as-judge), observability and responsible AI in regulated environments. MSc in Artificial Intelligence and AWS Certified Machine Learning Engineer, Associate.

bullets: Dissertation: ShastraShaw, a production multilingual legal RAG system (English, Hindi, Marathi).

work.title: AI Engineer (Part-time)
bullets: Delivered governed LLM workstreams across a 12-month responsible AI program, building 15+ prompt and guardrail configurations aligned with EU AI Act requirements.
Implemented safety refusals and content moderation logic that reduced non-compliant model outputs by ~30% across tested use cases.
Integrated LLMs, RAG and search into RAIMS APIs, improving retrieval precision by ~20% on internal compliance queries.
Optimized RAG data pipelines and RAIMS chat performance, cutting average response latency by ~25% for a multi-user platform.
Collaborated in a mentor-led agile team of 8+ engineers, shipping through Jira and GitLab in weekly sprints.
work.tech: LLMs, RAG, Guardrails, Prompt Engineering, REST APIs, EU AI Act, Jira, GitLab

work.title: AI Engineer
bullets: Developed and deployed production LLM and RAG solutions that automated document-analysis workflows, integrating with enterprise systems and cutting manual workloads by 20%.
Applied prompt engineering and structured output validation to improve the reliability and consistency of LLM outputs in production.
Engineered end-to-end MLOps pipelines (Docker, DVC, MLflow, GitHub Actions CI/CD), reducing model deployment time by 30% across compliance-focused financial-services projects.
Built production model monitoring with automated drift detection, fairness evaluation and explainability (SHAP, LIME), applying responsible-AI and data-privacy practices.
Built and deployed containerised Python APIs and LLM-enabled workflows on AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, S3, ECS).
Applied BERT and RoBERTa to document classification, improving accuracy by 15% and reducing training time by 25% with mixed-precision training.
Worked with technical and non-technical stakeholders to turn regulated-domain requirements into maintainable, testable AI solutions.
work.tech: Python, LLMs, RAG, BERT / RoBERTa, Docker, DVC, MLflow, GitHub Actions, AWS (SageMaker, Lambda, S3, ECS), SHAP, LIME

work.title: Junior AI Engineer
bullets: Built Python classification and regression models (scikit-learn, pandas) for an interactive learning platform.
Ran the full ML workflow: data cleaning, feature engineering, training, hyperparameter tuning and evaluation.
Used cross-validation, precision, recall and F1-score to compare models and reduce overfitting.
Worked with product and curriculum teams to translate user requirements into ML-driven features.

projects.name: ShastraShaw
projects.subtitle: Multilingual Legal RAG System
bullets: Eliminated hallucinated citations in a production legal-RAG system, raising automated faithfulness from 0.33 to 0.88 by building a multi-layer guardrail stack (anti-hallucination prompting, reranking, citation verification with auto-retry).
Lifted retrieval accuracy to a perfect 100% Hit@5 (from 93%) across a 4-domain legal benchmark by adding a cross-encoder reranking layer on top of hybrid BM25 + FAISS retrieval.
Built an LLMOps evaluation pipeline (RAGAS + lawyer-reviewed benchmarking) that more than tripled context precision (0.21 to 0.73), catching citation and legal-provision errors before deployment.
Operated the system as production infrastructure, not a prototype: AWS (EC2, S3, ECR), CloudWatch logging and alerting, rate-limiting, automated backups, Firebase auth.
Built a multilingual (English, Hindi, Marathi) legal assistant delivering grounded, actionable guidance across 4 legal domains, expanding access to justice for self-represented citizens.
projects.tech: GPT-4o, FAISS, BM25, Cross-Encoder Reranking, InLegalBERT, MarianMT, RAGAS, FastAPI, Docker, AWS (EC2, S3, CloudWatch), Firebase

projects.name: AriseAI
projects.subtitle: Agentic RAG Assistant
bullets: Built a LangGraph application covering query triage, retrieval, document grading, query reformulation and grounded answer generation over a FAISS vector store.
Added Pydantic structured outputs, citation verification and confidence-based fallbacks to reduce unsupported responses.
Created an LLM-as-judge evaluation harness measuring retrieval accuracy, faithfulness and relevance across a 30-question benchmark.
Cut LLM API calls per query from 3-4 to 2, added a 19-case Pytest regression suite and deployed with Docker.
projects.tech: LangGraph, Gemini, FAISS, Pydantic, Pytest, Docker

projects.name: Safe Waters
projects.subtitle: Agentic Advisory Pipeline
bullets: Orchestrated an agentic pipeline combining live environmental API data, model-based forecasting and rule-based guardrails, moving monitoring of 10 beaches from daily manual review to exception-only alerts.
Integrated GPT-4o tool-calling with retrieval-augmented context, grounding advisories in real-time regulatory data and prior human-reviewer feedback.
Designed auditable, human-in-the-loop escalation guardrails and validated the logic with automated tests.
projects.tech: GPT-4o, Tool Calling, RAG, API Integration

projects.name: SmartAQ
projects.subtitle: Forecasting with MLOps Pipeline
bullets: Built LSTM and LightGBM forecasting models, achieving a 15% RMSE reduction against the project baseline.
Created a reproducible DVC, Docker and GitHub Actions pipeline; deployed batch and real-time inference on AWS SageMaker with Step Functions and CloudWatch.
projects.tech: LSTM, LightGBM, AWS (SageMaker, Step Functions, CloudWatch), DVC, Docker, GitHub Actions
